fields.statement: The change set's intent also mentions that each rhiza apply write takes ~6 s on the VM (31 writes > 3 min) and points to 'the daemon CPU bug'. No open change set for that bug exists, and the fix (write-path or daemon CPU performance) has nothing to do with interview capture or m2-interviews-recorded. I recommend keeping it out of this change set: park it as a question in this change set, linked to nothing it blocks, so the gate raises it and the owner opens its own change set for it. Planning it here would mix a performance investigation into a small capture fix.
